name: Orvus – Schedules
description: Ask an assistant questions at fixed times (once, daily, weekly, every N hours).
long_description: Schedules questions to a connected assistant: once, daily, weekly or every N hours. Every run becomes a new chat (optionally in a project) and can be opened in the chat panel. Schedules run while Orvus is open; missed runs can be caught up when it opens. Functions that change something (level 4) are never executed by scheduled runs because nobody can confirm them.
author: KuroShiro
